fiscal.how_to_ask: A flow is measured over an interval and a balance is read at an instant; they are different kinds of number and may not be added. Ask read_fundamentals for the window you want — months=3 for a quarter, months=12 for a year — and it derives exactly that window from the periods this issuer filed, or refuses. It never returns a shorter period than the one you asked for.

price.name: price.volatility
price.describes: annualised volatility of the last N daily returns
price.authority: CFA Program, Quantitative Methods (return volatility); √252 annualisation is the industry convention
price.fails_when: fewer than 20 sessions in the window (VOL_MIN_OBS): refused with the counts, never shortened

price.name: price.beta
price.describes: OLS beta, alpha and R² of a name's daily returns on a benchmark's (default SPY)
price.authority: Sharpe (1964) market model; CFA Program, Portfolio Management (beta estimation)
price.fails_when: fewer than 60 aligned observations (BETA_MIN_OBS); a benchmark with no price history

price.name: price.momentum_12_1
price.describes: cumulative adjusted return from ~12 months back through 21 sessions back, the last month skipped
price.authority: Jegadeesh & Titman (1993), Returns to Buying Winners and Selling Losers
price.fails_when: fewer than 200 sessions of history (MOMENTUM_MIN_OBS); a formation window under 252 sessions is flagged

price.name: price.distance_from_52w_high
price.describes: how far the adjusted close sits below its trailing-year high, with the date the high was set
price.authority: George & Hwang (2004), The 52-Week High and Momentum Investing

price.name: price.adv
price.describes: average daily volume over the last N sessions, in shares and in dollars
price.authority: desk convention for days-to-liquidate arithmetic (20/30/60-session windows)
price.fails_when: fewer than 20 sessions (ADV_MIN_OBS) or no recorded volume

price.name: price.drawdown
price.describes: the deepest peak-to-trough fall of the adjusted close over a window: peak, trough, fall and depth, dated, with the recovery date if regained
price.authority: the standard drawdown definition (Magdon-Ismail, Atiya, Pratap & Abu-Mostafa, 2004)
price.fails_when: fewer than 20 sessions (DRAWDOWN_MIN_OBS); a window that never fell is stated, not zero

price.name: price.window_return
price.describes: total return over a named window, and relative to a benchmark when one is given
price.authority: total-return convention on split- and dividend-adjusted closes
price.fails_when: no price on or before either end of the window

how_to_read: Every name under `table` is a figure you can slot {ref, name} or use as an operand (ref:name) in compute. `methods` are what compute can produce for this subject; `procedures` are how an analyst approaches a kind of question about it; `not_held` and `cannot` are figures this desk does not have and why — say so, do not substitute. expand=<domain> opens one domain's detail.
withheld: Some measures this run computed are withheld pending validation and are not published anywhere on this desk: expected_shortfall_95, stress_loss_credit, stress_loss_market, stress_loss_rates, stress_loss_tech, var_95_1d, stress_results. Say so if asked; do not estimate them from other figures.
